ms.report:
Proof of Achievement – Final Milestone (Close Out Video)
We have resubmitted the Proof Of Achievement To add additional information requested from Catalyst.

1: Evidence that the properties are legitimately listed on the platform?
We have attached the service agreement with the property owners here: 
Service Agreement with 1st property Owner: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1cL8HnpWbPHobeCf3b632OzEGG-Q1WB31/view?usp=sharing 
Service Agreement with the 2nd property owner: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1As6y_FFyiW6H4bbmfpksxshGe4408ec5/view?usp=sharing 

2: Your PoA claims 2 real estate agencies are users. Can you provide evidence of this please?
We have attached the Memorandum Of Understanding bearing sufficient information with the Real Estate Agencies that own the properties listed here:
MOU With Mr Amuzie: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mfFBoOThrZiU8UTX4nA2vt0qV9CYMPlJ/view?usp=sharing 
MOU With Oaksvale: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1JIj2tJuZfQQwiUlssFQjRCNsCcvbFNM6/view?usp=sharing 

3: Can you also provide an update on what has happened since launch? Are there now fractional equity owners? How is this legally managed? and how is this verifiable on-chain?
Since our private mainnet launch, we have been taking feedback from our initial users to make improvements to the platform.
We currently don’t have any fractional equity owners yet, a user acquisition campaign is necessary to get initial users, we are working towards that.
Each tokenized property unit represents a stake in an actual real estate property that we have verified to be real. Once a property offering period has elapsed, a DAO will be set up with the governance and decisions managed by the Policy ID holders of the tokenized property units.
The Fractional properties are represented on-chain by their policy ID. But since no fractions have been bought on-chain, there’s no token currently on-chain.
